title: The pages block of site.config.json
$comment: Kept in step with properties.pages in site-config.schema.json by tests/test_pages.py. Edit both together.

home.description: The home page's file name (default index.html). The home page cannot be turned off, so false is not allowed.

enabled.description: false turns the page off without losing its other settings. Missing means true.

heading.description: The heading at the top of the page, if not the engine's.

stories.description: Stories: Markdown files in content/stories/. true or a settings object turns the page on; false turns it off. Missing means on, and the page appears once the site has a story.

enabled.description: false turns the page off without losing its other settings. Missing means true.

heading.description: The heading at the top of the page, if not the engine's.

tree.description: The family tree page: true, a file name, an object, or false to turn it off. null or missing means the site has no tree page.

enabled.description: false turns the page off without losing its other settings. Missing means true.

heading.description: The heading at the top of the page, if not the engine's.

map.description: The family map page (needs data/places.json): true, a file name, an object, or false to turn it off. null or missing means no map page.

enabled.description: false turns the page off without losing its other settings. Missing means true.

heading.description: The heading at the top of the page, if not the engine's.

records.description: Records and Research: the records the site relies on, from data/sources.json. true or a settings object turns it on; false turns it off. Missing means off, so a site that already has its own page for its sources is not changed.

discoveries.description: The Discovery Timeline page. When this is set it decides; when it is missing, timeline.enabled decides (the older setting, still read). See docs/discovery-timeline.md.

enabled.description: false turns the page off without losing its other settings. Missing means true.

heading.description: The heading at the top of the page, if not the engine's.

ask.description: Stuart's page: true, a file name, an object, or false to turn it off. null or missing means no Stuart.

description: The site's home page and which of the standard pages it has. A page that is turned off is not built, is left out of the navigation bar, and nothing links to it.
